description: Moves a file or folder in Google Drive to Trash. Takes the file ID. The item stays in Trash, where Drive deletes it for good after 30 days and where its owner can restore it before then; trashing a folder trashes what is inside it. Returns the item's ID, name and its trashed state as Drive reports it afterwards. Works on any Drive item the account is allowed to trash, including Docs, Sheets and Slides.

account.description: Optional email address of the connected account to use (e.g. 'user@gmail.com'). If omitted, the default account is used.

file_id.description: The Google Drive file or folder ID to move to Trash

name: gws-mcp__drive_trash_file
